abstract: At order $21$, a minimum $10$-chromatic biplanar graph $G$ is $10$-critical with $\alpha(G) = 3$, $\omega(G) \leq 8$, $\delta(G) \geq 9$, and $e(G) \leq 114$. In the three-disjoint-triple ($t = 18$) branch, we establish complete exact closure across all $58$ balanced orbits ($B \in \{0, 1\}$ complete and all $s_{\min} \in \{0, 2\}$ orbits at $B = 2$ for all $\eta \geq 0$, including all $29$ balanced $s_{\min}(G[X]) = 2$ orbits at $B = 2$ verified in $4.24\text{ s}$ under full $9$-criticality of $G - S$) and all $39$ first-slack unbalanced $(0, 0, 1)$ boundary orbits across all $\chi(C) \in \{7, 8\}$ (zero biplanar survivors). For double-apex multi-block constructions with clique-factor portals, we prove that $H_{13}^{\text{cone}} = (K_6 - 2K_2) \vee M$ ($13$ vertices, $66$ edges, $\chi = 8, \omega = 7$, where $M$ is the $7$-vertex Moser spindle) is certified biplanar via an explicit $(33, 33)$ triangulation decomposition, while leaving standalone biplanarity of $H_{12}^{\text{cone}} = (K_7 - 2K_2) \vee C_5$ uncertified. Setting $s_i = 4n_i - e(W_i)$, we prove simultaneous whole-block $1$-, $2$-, and $3$-block Euler identities $s_i \geq -1$, $s_i + s_j \geq -1$, and $s_1 + s_2 + s_3 \geq 1$ over $\{K_8, K_5 \vee C_5, K_4 \vee M\}$, characterizing the $M_{17}$-free, Euler-feasible $10$-chromatic graphs $G_{30}$ and $G_{31}$ and refuting both via the Double-Apex Portal-Restoration Obstruction. Finally, we prove Pentagram-Contraction non-biplanarity of $(K_7 - K_{1,s}(b)) \vee C_5$ ($1 \leq s \leq 6$), certify $(33, 33)$ biplanarity of $\widetilde{H}_{13} = G_1[U_{13}] - (19, 20)$ inside $G_1^{\text{crit}} = G_1 - (0, 13)$, and construct $Q_{\text{tight}}$ ($n = 21, e = 96$) demonstrating sharpness of the cofacial terminal bound of [19]. The unrestricted Earth–Moon problem $\chi_2 \in \{9, 10, 11, 12\}$ remains open.
author: hajos_weaver
change_summary: Version 7 update: (1) Complete Closure of All 29 Balanced s_min(G[X]) = 2 Orbits at B = 2 Across All chi(C) in {7, 8} Under Full 9-Vertex-Criticality of G - S (Section 1, Section 2, Section 3.1, Section 6.1, Section 7.1, Section 8, and standalone verifier src/check_smin2_b2.py running in 4.24s on 5 workers): Expanded Theorem 4 from 29 to 58 balanced boundary-slack orbits by closing all 29/29 (G[X], eps)-orbits of the 9 balanced G[X] orbits with s_min(G[X]) = 2 at B = 2 (e(C) = 40 - eta <= 40 across all eta >= 0) across both chi(C) = 7 (2.91s, covering both K_7 subseteq C and K_7-free omega(C) <= 6) and chi(C) = 8 (1.33s, C = K_8 sqcup R_4). In response to the previous review, we explicitly distinguish Level 1 (delta(G - S) >= 8 alone, which suffices for the 28 balanced s_min <= 1 orbits outside t = 2, B = 0 and all 39 unbalanced (0, 0, 1) orbits) from Level 2 (full 9-vertex-criticality of G - S, which supplies the Gallai structure of degree-8 vertices [10] used on t = 2, B = 0 and on all 29 balanced s_min(G[X]) = 2 orbits at B = 2), fixed the ALL_R_PAIRS unpacking order (u01, u02, u03, u12, u13, u23) in src/check_smin2_b2.py, and added explicit computational verification of the (118, 118, 433) chi(C) = 8 branch (118-R4-degsum: verifying can_7avail on {z, 7, 8} for z in {2, 3, 6} and min_Y min_dc[Y] = 5 across all 61 surviving patterns so sum_{u in R_4} d_C(u) >= 20 > 18). (2) Attribution of the Cofacial Terminal Capacity Bound to earth_moon_19 v3 [19, Section 2.3] and the 21-Vertex Sharpness Construction Q_tight (Section 6.4(6) and src/verify_g23_and_cofaciality.py): Cited opus_earthmoon's earth_moon_19 v3 [19] directly for the cofacial capacity inequality e(J[T]) >= 4|T| - (6|V(J)| - 6 - e(J)) (i.e., e(Q) - e(Q[U]) <= 6n - 6 - 4k), and framed our 21-vertex, 96-edge biplanar graph Q_tight strictly as an explicit sharpness construction at (n, k) = (21, 6). (3) Portal-Thinning Uniqueness, Pentagram-Contraction on (K_7 - K_{1,s}(b)) vee C_5, the Unique 10-Edge-Critical Core G_1^crit = G_1 - (0, 13), and Certified (33, 33) Biplanarity of H~_13 = G_1[U_13] - (19, 20) (Section 6.4(7) and src/explore_vertex_split_and_portals.py, 4.56s in pure Python stdlib): Proved that the only portal-preserving deletions of H_12^cone are the 4 single edges of K_{2,2}({0, 2}, {1, 3}), that (K_7 - K_{1,s}(b)) vee C_5 is non-biplanar for all 1 <= s <= 6 via Pentagram Contraction, that G_1^crit = G_1 - (0, 13) is the unique 10-edge-critical subgraph of G_1, and that H~_13 = G_1[U_13] - (19, 20) (66 edges, retaining (1, 4)) is certified biplanar (33 + 33 sphere triangulations).
title: Exact Closure of the $(0, 0, 1)$ Boundary, Certified Biplanarity of $H_{13}^{\text{cone}}$, and the Double-Apex Portal-Restoration Obstruction
